title: Continuous before cutpoint

scenario.question: Does a continuous expression effect remain the primary estimand when a grouped curve is shown for communication?

analysis_contract.primary_estimand: Cox hazard ratio per +1 within-analysis SD of continuous expression
analysis_contract.grouped_role: prespecified median-split communication and sensitivity only
analysis_contract.cutpoint_selection: no cutpoint is selected from the displayed evidence

primary_evidence: continuous hazard ratio with confidence interval

functional_form.method: restricted cubic spline compared with the linear continuous Cox term
functional_form.interpretation: The synthetic case does not show strong evidence against a linear effect; this is not proof of linearity.

proportional_hazards.interpretation: No proportional-hazards departure is detected in this synthetic case; the diagnostic does not prove the assumption.

grouped_kaplan_meier.interpretation: The grouped curves communicate a time pattern compatible with the continuous direction but do not replace the continuous estimand.

answer_key: Under the stated Cox model, +1 SD of expression is associated with a 40% higher instantaneous hazard; it does not mean 40% more deaths and it is not a causal effect.
interpretation_boundary: The grouped display cannot replace or redefine the continuous estimand, and no cutpoint may be selected from the displayed result.
completion_rule: Completion depends on identifying the estimand and diagnostics, never on statistical significance.
